# Model Verification

This layer includes files that handle the installation, selection, and verification of models.

## Responsibilities

- **Install Ollama Release**: Manages the installation of the Ollama release.

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`src/install-ollama.js`](../src/install-ollama.js) | Installs the Ollama release. | `InstallError`, `checkInstall`, `installOllama`, `pinnedArchive`, `readPins`, `download` |
| [`src/models.js`](../src/models.js) | Picks the Ollama models for this run. | `COMMENT_MODEL`, `DOCS_MODEL`, `FALLBACK_DOCS_MODEL`, `DOCS_MODEL_MIN_GIB`, `parseMemTotal`, `readTotalMemory` |
| [`src/ollama.js`](../src/ollama.js) | Minimal client for the Ollama server on the runner. | `DEFAULT_HOST`, `baseUrl`, `chat`, `describeError`, `loggedChat`, `request` |
| [`src/precheck.js`](../src/precheck.js) | The pre-check, run before models are selected or Ollama is installed. | `precheck`, `plural`, `writeOutputs` |
| [`src/verify-models.js`](../src/verify-models.js) | Checks each pulled model against pins/models.json before any code reaches it. | `ModelDigestError`, `compareBlobs`, `readPins`, `referencedDigests`, `verifyFiles`, `verifyModels` |

## How it works

- **src/install-ollama.js**: This file handles the installation of the Ollama release. It defines functions like `checkInstall`, `installOllama`, and `sha256File` to ensure that the installation process is successful and the models are correctly downloaded and extracted.
- **src/precheck.js**: This file runs a pre-check before models are selected or Ollama is installed. It defines functions like `precheck` and `writeOutputs` to ensure that the pre-check process is successful.

## Configuration

- Environment variables: `BASE_BRANCH`, `GITHUB_OUTPUT`, `GITHUB_PATH`, `OLLAMA_DIR`, `OLLAMA_HOST`, `OLLAMA_MODELS`, `OLLAMA_VERSION`, `RUNNER_TEMP`.
- Action inputs: `backlog-batch-size`, `comment-level`, `context-tokens`, `docs-dir`, `docs-model`, `exclude`, `existing-code`, `extensions`, `job-timeout-minutes`, `model`, `path`, `time-budget-minutes`.
- Configuration files: `pins/models.json`, `pins/ollama.json`.
